messages:
pagerduty-bot: [P1] High-severity: Multiple unexpected PUTs to s3://redwood-prod-audits/ from IP 52.14.23.8. Service account: infra-logger. Potential sensitive audit data uploaded externally.
eng-oncall: ack — I'm taking; paging oncall.
alice.nguyen: pulling object list now, will check contents.
ben_jacobs: pinging @security-sre and @maria.ortiz, possible customer-impact.
security-sre: oncall here — stand by. Can you paste the object keys?
alice.nguyen: keys: audit-2026-03-18-09-12-02.log.gz, audit-2026-03-18-09-12-03.log.gz, audit-2026-03-18-09-14-50.log.gz
alice.nguyen: quick grep shows lines with customer emails and partial tokens. first check looks like exported audit lines (user.email, request_id, resource_path).
maria.ortiz: pause the log forwarder pipeline? If it's still running it'll keep pushing.
eng-oncall: pausing deployment now — applying patch.
eng-oncall: ```kubectl -n infra patch deploy log-forwarder -p '{"spec":{"paused":true}}'```
eng-oncall: paused, rollout stalled. No further uploads from that pipeline in last 30s.
ben_jacobs: security-sre can you rotate infra-logger service account keys and revoke current creds?
security-sre: starting rotation playbook: sec-rotate-keys v2. Step1: revoke active keys for svcacct/infra-logger.
security-sre: revocation output: "revoked key id fk_3f9a — status OK"
security-sre: creating replacement creds and provisioning to a sealed vault for redeploy after validation.
alice.nguyen: copying affected objects to preservation bucket s3://redwood-incident-preserve/incident-1768701234/ (immutably backed up).
alice.nguyen: command used: ```aws s3 cp s3://redwood-prod-audits/audit-2026-03-18-09-12-02.log.gz s3://redwood-incident-preserve/incident-1768701234/ --region us-west-2```
ben_jacobs: found remote endpoints contacted by the uploader: 18.204.0.5 and 3.129.45.12 — opening abuse reports.
security-sre: starting data-scope assessment. Early estimate: 2 customer tenants' audit files referenced in the objects.
maria.ortiz: drafting customer notification; keeping language minimal: what happened, timeframe, actions taken, what we're doing next.
legal-bot: template ready — include exact object keys, detection time, mitigation steps, recommended customer actions (rotate keys if they store exported logs).
eng-oncall: any sign this was internal misconfig? CI job name in log metadata: ci-logshipper/rotate-logs-run-72 — looks like a misconfigured artifact upload in CI.
alice.nguyen: confirmed tracer: job ran with svcacct credentials that had overly broad s3:PutObject perms.
ben_jacobs: action item: tighten CI role to least-privilege, remove PutObject to external buckets, only allow writes to internal audit bucket.
security-sre: creating SOC ticket sec-2026-154 and JIRA INC-176870 for postmortem + followups. Assigning to @alice.nguyen for lead, @ben_jacobs for infra fixes, @maria.ortiz for comms.
eng-oncall: preserving all relevant logs and timestamps. Notifying cloud provider abuse for the external IPs.
maria.ortiz: sending initial customer notices now (template with TLP: AMBER). cc: legal.
legal-bot: reviewed language, ok to send. Recommend holding broad press comms until RCA.
charlie_roberts: taking over overnight handoff for mitigation tasks. @alice.nguyen please handoff any running queries and the preservation location.
alice.nguyen: handing off — preserved objects at s3://redwood-incident-preserve/incident-1768701234/, grep snippets saved to /tmp/incident-1768701234-snippets.txt.
ben_jacobs: immediate infra patch: CI role policy updated to deny s3:PutObject on external buckets; new policy attached to CI roles.
security-sre: monitoring outbound egress from infra network for anomalous destinations for next 24h.
eng-oncall: status update for pagerduty: mitigations applied, keys rotated, forwarder paused, preservation complete. Recommend full RCA and customer follow-up tomorrow.
charlie_roberts: acknowledged, will lead postmortem doc and timeline tomorrow morning.
alice_nguyen: I'll create RCA skeleton and timeline in the incident JIRA by 09:30 PT.
ben_jacobs: great. :+1:
security-sre: closing live mitigation phase, moving to investigation/tracing.
pagerduty-bot: Incident marked: mitigated -> monitoring.
